# asc_security_group_attachment (Data Source)

Retrieves a specific Security Group attachment in the DSPC platform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "asc_security_group_attachment" "example" {
  security_group_name = "my-sg"
  attachment_name     = "my-vm-my-sg-attach"
}

# Output the attachment details
output "attachment_id" {
  description = "The ID of the security group attachment"
  value       = data.asc_security_group_attachment.example.id
}

output "attachment_sg_name" {
  description = "The security group name"
  value       = data.asc_security_group_attachment.example.security_group_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `attachment_name` (String) The name of the attachment resource.
- `security_group_name` (String) The name of the Security Group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the security group attachment.
